title: Orders per customer
prompt: Return each customer_id and the number of orders they have placed, as a column named order_count.
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE sales (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, customer_id INTEGER, amount REAL); INSERT INTO sales VALUES (1,1,50.0),(2,1,30.0),(3,2,20.0),(4,3,90.0),(5,2,15.0),(6,3,10.0),(7,1,25.0);
reference_sql: SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM sales GROUP BY customer_id;
